title: 2-D DCT
text: Compute 2-D discrete cosine transform (DCT), 1 input, 1 output, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point representation; {Sine and cosine computation} sets how the block computes the sine and cosine terms Table, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow mode, {Sine Table} sets the data type of sine table, {Product output} sets the data type of product output, {Accumulator} sets the data type of accumulator, {Output} sets the data type of output and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sine and cosine computation
params.values: Specify how the block computes the sine and cosine terms Table lookup (default) | Trigonometric fcn

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point representation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Sine Table
params.values: Data type of sine table Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Product output
params.values: Data type of product output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Data type of accumulator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
